question: P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. U sits to the immediate right of T. Only three people sit between U and V when counted from the left of U. Only three people sit between T and R. Q sits to the immediate right of P. How many people sit between T and P when counted from the left of P?
solution:
**Given: **P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

U sits to the immediate right of T. Only three people sit between U and V when counted from the left of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e61248d2035ebd8f5566daca7e57ac570a1008e45a79050a16707f58346040e.png] 

Only three people sit between T and R. Q sits to the immediate right of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d3a2d86809ce60282407df69111c1a15e0e5e9f9813057a69083bc55652aabe.png] 

Thus, Only four people sit between T and P when counted from the left of P.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
